pr_title: GameEngine: route AI Studio selections to ACP drivers
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the AI Studio preference-routing layer on top of the ACP Foundation baseline. Stable user-facing AI IDs remain unchanged while process-local execution routing can explicitly choose Legacy or an ACP registry agent ID. ACP-bound targets fail closed when their adapter is unavailable; there is no silent Legacy fallback. Managed Local keeps `model:managed_local:<id>` while sharing one driver route for Goose integration.

This is a parallel authoring subtask. Heavy cargo, Windows, and Visual Validation are intentionally deferred to final ACP integration; any validation automatically started by the trusted protocol is not bypassed.

## Integration

Final ACP integration should register adapter runtimes, synchronize the registry snapshot, bind Codex / Claude Code / Managed Local to their ACP descriptor IDs, and replace the routing-only ACP dispatch guard with the integrated ACP session/run handoff. Legacy bindings remain the explicit rollback boundary.
